description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Colfenor and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Spawn dies, triggering Colfenor, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
